summary: PT Telekomunikasi Indonesia (Telkom Indonesia) filed a Form 6-K with the SEC on July 31, 2026, containing its unaudited consolidated financial statements for the six months ended June 30, 2026, along with a statement of directors' responsibility. The filing is a routine periodic report by a foreign private issuer, not a special-situations transaction. It includes balance sheet data in billions of Rupiah but discloses no acquisitions, divestitures, or other corporate events. This is a standard regulatory filing with no unusual or event-driven content.
